about: Source data for the brand comparison pages under directory/compare/: one "Suede AI Skills Directory vs <name>" page and one "<name> alternatives" page per entry, both listed on the compare hub. scripts/build-directory.mjs renders them; scripts/directory/versus.mjs validates this file. Every competitor fact names a source in that entry's sources list, fetched on the entry's checked date; re-check each source before changing a fact. Suede AI's own figures are never written here: {skills}, {repos}, {categories}, {full}, {shielded}, {tasks}, {alternatives}, {snapshot}, {installs_matched} and {installs_date} are filled from the live directory data at build time. A null fact renders as not stated by the cited sources. Competitor pricing is never written here (owner direction, 2026-11-05): every competitor's price row renders as "Pricing varies" linked to the competitor's site, and scripts/directory/versus.mjs rejects a price fact or any price wording in competitor copy.

competitors.name: skills.sh
competitors.summary: skills.sh is the agent skills leaderboard Vercel runs. It ranks skills by installs counted from anonymous telemetry in the open-source skills CLI (github.com/vercel-labs/skills), with All Time, Trending (24h) and Hot views, and it runs routine security audits that check skills for malicious content. The leading skill, find-skills, showed 4.2M installs on November 3, 2026.
